query: SELECT u.id,u.email FROM captured_sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.organization_id=$1 AND s.current_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR s.user_id=$2 OR s.sharing_mode='workspace' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_session_grants g JOIN users recipient ON recipient.id=g.user_id WHERE g.captured_session_id=s.id AND g.user_id=$2 AND recipient.active=true)) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR lower(u.email) LIKE $3 ESCAPE E'\\') GROUP BY u.id,u.email ORDER BY (u.id=$4) DESC,u.email LIMIT 10
